instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: ISO 9000 and Its Relation to the CMM

questions.question: How many clauses does ISO 9001 use?
questions.explanation: ISO 9001 is written in clauses, and they number twenty in the standard.
questions.explanation_ar: معيار ISO 9001 مكتوب بنود، وعددها عشرون.

questions.question: In ISO 9126, each characteristic is broken down into...
questions.question_ar: في ISO 9126، كل خاصية تتفرّع إلى...
questions.explanation: Each characteristic carries a set of sub-characteristics called attributes.
questions.explanation_ar: كل خاصية تحمل مجموعة من الخصائص الفرعية المسماة سمات.

questions.question: ISO 9000 is a series of quality management standards and has...
questions.question_ar: ISO 9000 سلسلة معايير لإدارة الجودة وتحتوي...
questions.explanation: The ISO 9000 family covers the standard and its companions.

questions.question: What is the main difference in emphasis between ISO 9001 and the CMM?
questions.question_ar: ما الفارق الأساسي في التركيز بين ISO 9001 ونموذج النضج؟
options: the CMM stresses continuous process improvement
ISO 9001 applies only to software here
the CMM concerns documentation only now
options_ar: نموذج النضج يركّز على تحسين العملية المستمر
ISO 9001 ينطبق على البرمجيات فقط الآن
نموذج النضج يهتم بالتوثيق فقط هنا أيضاً
ISO 9001 يركّز على التغيير المستمر مجدداً
options_en: the CMM stresses continuous process improvement
ISO 9001 applies only to software here
the CMM concerns documentation only now
questions.explanation: ISO 9001 certifies a quality management system; the CMM rates process maturity.
questions.explanation_ar: ISO 9001 يشهد على نظام إدارة جودة، ونموذج النضج يقيّم نضج العملية.

questions.question: ISO 9001 applies to...
questions.explanation: The standard is generic, which is why it covers far more than software.
questions.explanation_ar: المعيار عام، ولهذا يغطي أكثر بكثير من البرمجيات.

questions.question: What do ISO 9001 and the CMM share?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تشترك فيه ISO 9001 ونموذج النضج؟
options: both require the same levels again
options_ar: كلاهما يقيس جودة الكود هنا أيضاً
options_en: both require the same levels again
questions.explanation: Both push an organisation to write down what it does and do it consistently.
questions.explanation_ar: كلاهما يدفع المنظمة لتوثيق ما تفعله وفعله باتساق.

questions.question: Why did the CMM arise alongside ISO 9001?
questions.question_ar: لماذا ظهر نموذج النضج بجانب ISO 9001؟
options: the CMM replaced the ISO now again
the CMM came from hardware makers
software process needed its own model
ISO 9001 was withdrawn here too here here
options_ar: نموذج النضج حلّ محل ISO مجدداً الآن
نموذج النضج جاء من صانعي العتاد
سُحب ISO 9001 هنا الآن أيضاً هنا
options_en: the CMM replaced the ISO now again
the CMM came from hardware makers
software process needed its own model
ISO 9001 was withdrawn here too here here
questions.explanation: Quality management was generic, so software needed a maturity ladder of its own.
questions.explanation_ar: إدارة الجودة كانت عامة، فاحتاجت البرمجيات سُلّم نضج خاصاً بها.

questions.question: How is CMM progress usually assessed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُقاس التقدم في نموذج النضج عادةً؟
options: by counting the lines of code here again here
by the number of meetings held now here
by the number of bugs reported too
by formal assessment by trained assessors
options_ar: بعدد أسطر الكود هنا أيضاً هنا
options_en: by counting the lines of code here again here
by the number of meetings held now here
by the number of bugs reported too
by formal assessment by trained assessors
questions.explanation: Certified assessments are what actually place an organisation on a level.
questions.explanation_ar: التقييمات الرسمية هي ما يضع المنظمة فعلاً على مستوى.
